implemented_requirements.requirement: Generate Fibonacci numbers up to a given number
implemented_requirements.evidence: def fibonacci_up_to(limit): ... while a <= limit: result.append(a) ... returns list of Fibonacci numbers up to and including limit. The main() function parses a numeric limit from command‑line or interactive input and calls run(limit) which prints the sequence.
